pages.text: In the Overworld, light a fire on bedrock or ordinary deepslate. Let it burn for a little over 13 seconds at the default setting. When a mature fire goes out, it can drop Grains of Infinity.

Bedrock has an 80% chance to drop 1–3 grains. Deepslate has a 40% chance to drop one grain and becomes cobblestone on a successful roll. If a flame goes out too early, relight it and try several blocks. Keep the grains for $(l:enderio:getting_started/machine_parts)machine parts$(/l).
